title: Check Hsiao against the 2025-2026 Data Frontiers successor roster
summary: Compare the official current Global Future Council on Data Frontiers roster with the completed 2023-2024 Data Equity roster to determine whether Hsiao appears on the successor council, while treating roster absence only as a bounded current-roster result.

selection_reason: WEF explicitly launched a 2025-26 GFC term after concluding 2023-24; checking the successor data-governance roster tests continuity versus termination.
